info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Market Information Retrieval API
info.description: The Market Information Retrieval API provides easy access to crucial market data. This API allows consumers to fetch detailed insights related to market information management by utilizing specific parameters. It is aimed at financial analysts, developers, and market researchers who need to integrate real-time market information into their applications. Users can efficiently retrieve data based on various criteria, enabling informed decision-making in a dynamic business environment.

get.summary: Retrieve market information for a specific resource.
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch detailed market information associated with the specified resource identifier. It provides insights into market trends, pricing, and other relevant data essential for informed decision-making.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters for retrieving market information regarding the specified resource. Ensure that all required data is correctly formatted and included for a successful response.

200.description: Request completed successfully and data returned.
